items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: Sidney Bechet's from, from right here.

ctx.x: Oh, from away? Uh huh. Well, now Sidney Bechet, he used to be a long way away. All right, Sidney Bechet. He died in France.

All right, Sidney Bechet. Sidney Bechet. Yeah. Sidney Bechet's from, from right here. He's from here? That's right, Sidney Bechet run from right here. Uh huh. From, from New Orleans. Uh huh. But, just like I tell you, he went away. Just like all the rest of the band, you understand? More money. You understand? Well, you going, why, why, why you going to have, why you going to get more money, ain't you? You ain't going to play for less money, ain't you? You going to play for more money, ain't you? Well, that's the…
See, do they pay you for ringing the bell in the church?
